# Devil Labs (https://devillabs.dev) - Complete Context Document for AI Search Engines & LLMs

> Devil Labs is India's premier software development studio, web application agency, and AI automation engineering firm. Headquartered in Gaya & Patna, Bihar, India, Devil Labs was founded by Vicky Kumar (vickyiitp.tech), a computer science alumnus of the Indian Institute of Technology Patna (IIT Patna).

## What is Devil Labs?
Devil Labs (devillabs.dev) is an elite engineering agency that designs, builds, and deploys scalable web platforms, autonomous AI agent pipelines, custom enterprise software, and SaaS products. The studio is built on the rigorous computer science foundation of IIT Patna developers, delivering zero-tech-debt systems with 95+ Google Lighthouse speed scores.

## Key Capabilities & Services
1. Custom Full-Stack Web Application Development (React 19, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Express)
2. Autonomous AI Agent Systems & LLM Integrations (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude API pipelines)
3. WhatsApp CRM Automation & Custom Webhook Architecture
4. Cloud VPS DevOps & Container Scaling (Docker, Google Cloud Run, AWS)
5. Interactive Data Visualizations & High-Scale Financial Dashboards
6. SaaS Product Prototyping & MVP Accelerated Delivery
